positive_snippets:
I had a pleasant stay at Hotel Red Flame Residency. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and comfortable. The staff was polite, helpful, and always ready to assist with any request. The hotel’s location is convenient — close to major attractions and easy to reach by public transport.

The amenities were satisfactory, offering good value for money.
negative_snippets: I booked this hotel online. The amount was 680 for a classic room, and I had set pay at hotel. But when I arrived, the hotel staff refused to book and asked me to pay 1,000 for a non-classic room. If you don't want to book online, just turn it off.
What is the price of your hotel for 24 hours?
